caption:
a day that looks like nothing and changes everything 🤍

#slowliving #routine #wellness

slides.text:
A day that looks
like nothing

A glass of water
before the coffee

A plate you didn't
have to think about

A bag packed
the night before

A lamp on
and the screen off

slides.heading: Nothing happens, then everything does
slides.body: SOMA makes the small decisions — the meal, the session, the bedtime — so the boring day is the one that works
